about.title: Version
about.desktopNote: Desktop builds can check for updates in Settings.
about.browserNote: The browser build does not check for updates.
update.title: Updates
update.hint: Check and install new versions from GitHub Releases.
update.installing: Downloading and installing; the app will restart when it's done…
update.readonly: This folder is read-only, so the app cannot update itself. Download the new build and replace it manually.
ai.title: AI
ai.browserNote: The browser build cannot store a key or call the AI. Configure it in the desktop app.
ai.providerNote: OpenAI compatible endpoints work; local Ollama and LM Studio do not need a key.
ai.keyNote: The key is stored in the OS credential store (Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain) and never written to a config file.
ai.keylessNote: Local models need no key; point the base URL at the local service.
ai.clearAllNote: Deletes every key this app stored in the OS credential store, including other providers. Uninstalling does not remove credentials, so clear them before handing the machine over.

help.title: Help
help.focusBody: Click the focus mode button at the bottom of the sidebar to enter fullscreen. Press Esc to exit.
help.focusNote: Focus mode hides the taskbar and restores the previous window state when you exit.
help.windowOrder: From top to bottom at the bottom of the sidebar: minimize, focus mode, exit.
help.windowDrag: The window has no title bar. Drag the sidebar background to move it, and drag the edges to resize.
